title: Managed Database: handling primary per-node reconciliation
content:
## Business purpose
Managed Database primary per-node reconciliation supports the requested account correction. Update only the existing pending service assessment whose external reference is Primary per-node reconciliation. A completed source quantity reconciliation is a nonfinancial entitlement assessment; original meters and invoices are preserved.

## Capability
Complete the per-node database usage assessment by replacing its quantity and setting completed status. The resulting corrected usage assessment is immediately visible to account readers.

## Invocation
post_primary_average_31a3f059 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters
- database_event_id: Reference — Identifier of the pending database usage assessment record obtained from find_database_events.
- quantity: Decimal — Reconciled average node usage; unit node-hour. Decimal quantity to six decimal places, round half-up once at submission; no empty value.

## Successful return
String receipt with database_event_id (assessment reference), quantity (node-hour decimal to six places) and completed status, confirming the changed usage assessment.
